bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 8. ADASITI was beaten at short odds second up at Albury but he did refuse to shirk his task on the day and he will present race-fitter here third up. He can atone! HEART BALM paid too great a price for drawing an awkward gate last start at Wagga when his unplaced effort was better than it appears at face value. CALLISTEMON must be forgiven for an unplaced latest effort on the inner track at Morphettville when she had too much to do on the day. KING INCANTO wasn't disgraced at Wodonga and stepping up from 1300m should aid his cause this afternoon.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 6, 9, 10, 14. SHARP REMARK performed well above market place expectations at Wangaratta when she stepped up to tackle this distance at only her second run in her first campaign. Natural improvement can now be expected. FOUR ESSES kept trying in defeat after she endured a tough run in transit at Gundagai. In the process, she indicated that she should now relish an awaiting distance rise. I'VE FORGOTTEN was competing for only the second time in his first campaign when his unplaced Albury effort over 1175m was better than it appears on paper. He's another who can now appreciate this longer distance. CLASSIC CRACKER struck early trouble at MIldura and her unplaced effort must be overlooked.

She has done enough before her break to be treated with great respect today. BYGO LASS trialed eleven days ago at Gundagai when the track was assessed as soft seven. bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8. JUSTBETRYIN' presents fourth up. He looked the part with Dale Cole aboard over this distance last start at Gundagai and he should have more to offer this afternoon with Dale retaining the ride. REDS CITY can be forgiven for an unplaced Forbes effort last start when she was produced after a twenty-seven day break. A quicker back-up should now aid her cause at her second outing since a stable change. SEE YOU THEN struck too many traffic problems first up from a long spell at Albury. She can now make a mockery of her unplaced effort on that occasion. TIME ANGEL finished unplaced third up at Wodonga but he was anything but disgraced and he still has scope to improve.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 8, 9, 11, 14. UNDERCUT is resuming after three Flemington jump-outs last month. He was a first up winner within this distance range when he began his last preparation after gear changes had been made and he is suitably placed first up again this afternoon. OZZY THE EQUALISER was presented over this distance at Gundagai when he became unsuited in transit after a more than ten week break. He can only now appreciate this quicker back-up. SUNDROP, despite racing greenly, didn't finish far from the winner at Gundagai and he can play a part again today without causing a surprise. BOY FROM TENNESSEE overcame traffic problems to score fourth up at Wagga and he can be expected to maintain his form today.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 6, 8, 10, 12. DEEKAYGEEBEE finished unplaced on the Acton track at Canberra but he hadn't been to the races for seventy-one days when his effort was honest and this quicker back-up opens the door to improvement. DENSETSU did a terrific job to finish as close to the winner as he did at Wangaratta. He had no luck on the day! GRINZINGER NYX shouldn't be harshly judged for and unplaced latest effort at Albury and she should appreciate a drop in class today. DITA VON performed above market place expectations within this distance range at Gundagai with Bradley Vale aboard. She can maintain her form with Bradley retaining the ride here.
